detail.overview: TheAnt Flora Powerlift Digital Body Weighing Scaleis designed for accurate and convenient everyday weight measurement with a maximum capacity of180kg. Equipped withhigh-precision strain gauge sensors, it delivers reliable readings for regular weight tracking at home.
features: TheAnt Flora Powerlift Digital Body Weighing Scaleis designed for accurate and convenient everyday weight measurement with a maximum capacity of180kg. Equipped withhigh-precision strain gauge sensors, it delivers reliable readings for regular weight tracking at home.

The scale features a durable4mm tempered glass platformcombined with anABS body, providing a strong and modern construction. Its slimskid-proof designoffers improved stability when placed on a flat, hard surface.

A clearLCD displayprovides quick weight readings within approximately3 seconds, while theautomatic power-off function activates after 8 secondsto help conserve battery life. The built-inlow-battery indicatoralerts you when the batteries need replacement.

Powered by2 AAA batteries, included with the product, the Ant Flora Powerlift is ready to use out of the box. For accurate results and safe operation, place the scale on a flat, hard surface and avoid using it on carpets or exposing it to water.
